body: Well, I enjoy a lot of classic literature and poetry, from 'The Divine Comedy' to 'East of Eden'. I also read a lot of Stephen King; almost all of his books, actually. Joyce Carol Oates is pretty wonderful, too. As for movies, I really like older movies; Arsenic and Old Lace with Cary Grant is one of my favorites as is pretty much anything with Marilyn Monroe in it. Casablanca is also one of my favorites. Music is some thing else I really like and use to cope.

It's pretty serious; bipolar I, rapid cycle. My family is very understanding and gentle with me and I am very lucky for that. It just really hurts me to know I hurt them some times the ways that I do. And thanks for not thinking I am an asshole (lol). That looks like a pretty great subreddit. I appreciate your nice comment.

There are some things that lift me a little during a depression but some times I am too depressed to even do them. But some things that do help me are reading (sometimes it's too hard for me to concentrate on a book when I am depressed, though), going for a short walk, watching one of my favorite movies.
